📁 Jensen Huang, CEO of NVIDIA, says GPT was never just about generating images or text but about generating thought itself. 

The real shift is that AI is no longer becoming a tool you query occasionally but a system that reasons continuously. 

Once computers stop waiting for commands and start thinking persistently, every layer of computing and human work gets rebuilt.
